Pumps, hoses, manure, and biogas: The Pumps N' Hoses Pack is now available for Farming Simulator 25, improved and free of charge! Developed by Creative Mesh and published by GIANTS Software, the pack adds three gameplay systems that give you more options to manage manure, fertilize your fields, and produce energy on your farm.
And there is plenty of equipment to go with it: More than 40 new machines, tools, buildings, and other items are included, featuring specialist brands Schouten, Stallkamp, BvL, and 2G Energy.
Three New Systems for Your Farm
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/4ae1cdb9addd8d6739ab7c3f976daa27ad1d6d73.jpg"]

Pumps N' Hoses expands the way you handle agricultural resources with three distinct gameplay systems: umbilical systems, manure separation, and configurable biogas plants. Together, they give you more ways to organize manure distribution, storage, and energy production.

Want to fertilize your fields without hauling a conventional slurry tanker across them? With umbilical systems, you can connect and combine hoses around your farm to supply ultra-light drag hose injectors directly in the field.
Make More of Your Manure
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/142b750da1ac69d7b100744f47125bdb254a72c2.jpg"]

Manure separation adds another step to your resource management. You can separate manure into liquid and solid components, giving you more flexibility when storing and applying the resulting materials.
That means more options for organizing your operation and making efficient use of the resources already available on your farm.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/8c50cf6dc6e04fe15f9f28db6bc5aae1de7d013c.jpg"]
Biogas production becomes more flexible, too. Instead of relying on a single predefined setup, you can configure your biogas plant according to the requirements of your farm.
Combine different components and create a high-performing facility that fits your infrastructure and the way you want to run your operation.
More Than 40 New Items

The new gameplay systems come with more than 40 additional machines, tools, buildings, and other items. More than 30 of them come from Dutch manufacturer Schouten, German steel storage specialist Stallkamp, biogas feeding technology manufacturer BvL, and 2G Energy.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/8f091d6dae9bc0fb01049909a60d89d70e18de98.jpg"]

With Farming Simulator 25 recently reaching five million players, the Pumps N' Hoses Pack is available now as a free addition for the community. Get your hoses connected, separate that manure, configure your biogas plant, and put the new systems to work on your farm!

We released the free Content Update #4 for Farming Simulator 25. Patch 1.15 included! We're adding real powerhouses of machinery from John Deere and Case IH for everyone. And you've been asking for them. Check them out below!
Please Note! The patch is being rolled out across platforms. It can take some time until the update becomes available on your system. Crossplay services may be affected in the meantime.
John Deere’s Most Powerful Tractor

We're introducing the John Deere 9RX Series (710-830). With the 9RX 830 top-configuration, you can operate John Deere’s current top-end articulated four‑track tractor that only rolled onto real fields last year.

Built for very large-scale, high-draft tillage, seeding, and heavy implement work, it combines an 18‑liter Deere engine, high-capacity hydraulics, and a heavy, high-traction chassis - making it the biggest, most powerful tractor in Farming Simulator 25.

Special Edition: Power in Lime Green

With Case IH, another fan-favorite brand spotlights this content update, spearheaded with the Steiger 715-785 Quadtrac Special Edition. Rather than red, the customary Case IH color, this special Quadtrac comes painted in lime green - a nod to the original color of the iconic Steiger brand that has become an integral part of Case IH.

While this agricultural giant adds another machine to the large tractor category, the Patriot 4450 and Vestrum Series are also introduced in the iconic red color of Case IH, providing more compact solutions for a variety of tasks.

Farming Simulator 25 gets a substantial boost in realism with Precision Farming 3.0. With more than five million downloads since we released the initial version, we had to bring it back. And we've added new features in addition to existing ones - find out more below!
Available Now!
DE Precision Farming 3.0 Now Available - Free Pack!
Tramlines & Subsidies
In this new and improved iteration of Precision Farming, tramlines help you plant like a pro -guiding your machinery along the same paths each time for cleaner fields and healthier crops.
If you're planting catch crops like oilseed radish, you'll get rewarded with in-game subsidies for choosing eco-friendly, nitrogen-saving methods over standard fertilizing. Just like the real deal!
PWM & Section Control

Precision Farming 3.0 also adds some cool tech: Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) - a fancy name for sprayers that can adjust output on the fly. Instead of just blasting fertilizer nonstop, PWM lets each nozzle do its own thing, pulsing out just the right amount depending on your speed or turns. That means less waste and better coverage.

We also add Automatic Section Control: Your machines will now switch individual parts on or off as needed - no more over-spraying or missing spots. It's cleaner, smarter, and better for the environment.
New Machines & Retro-Fit Sensors

You’ve got six machines to play with in this update, including the John Deere R975i sprayer and the HAWE body swap system. Ever wanted to turn a trailer into a high-end slurry tanker? Now you can with the Wienhoff 25.200 PTW Profi Line that comes with a manure sensor.
And for those of you sticking with other sprayers, you can upgrade them with PTx Trimble WeedSeeker2 sensors to spot-spray weeds like a boss. Simply retrofit them!
What's Precision Farming?
Haven't played Precision Farming with Farming Simulator 19 or Farming Simulator 22? Let's do a short recap, huh?
Precision Farming was initiated by EIT Food, Europe’s leading Food Innovation Initiative, in cooperation with John Deere, educational institutions, and other partners.
Co-funded by the European Union, the initial goal was meant to highlight sustainable technology in agriculture to create awareness in the general population.
Farming Simulator was basically offering itself as a vehicle to transport the awareness of sustainable farming, reaching millions of players world-wide.

Other partners of the project: The University of Hohenheim (Germany), the University of Reading (UK), Grupo AN (the largest cereal cooperative in Spain), and the Institute of Animal Reproduction and Food Research of Polish Academy of Sciences.

•scroll to to top' (home) and 'scroll to bottom' (end) (when typing is not enabled)
•scroll 1 page by holding shift while pressing page up or down (when typing is not enabled)
Additional notes
As with all major updates, you may experience stuttering on the first game launch after updating. Especially when using mods or custom graphics settings due to shaders being recompiled.
